Scientific boundary

What this MVP can and cannot answer

The Gassum view now uses nine successful OPM Flow 2026.04 CO2STORE simulations. Its P10/P50/P90 fields span low, central, and high permeability, porosity, and net-thickness cases. The CO₂ plume layer is read directly from simulated gas saturation.

This remains a generic regional screening model, not a history-matched or permitting model. Other formations still use the analytical proxy. Decisions require calibrated geology and fluids, fault transmissibilities, coupled geomechanics, operational well constraints, monitoring data, and review by qualified reservoir and geomechanics specialists.
